title: automate lead assignment notifications in affiliate manager workflows
text:
Use Affiliate Manager workflows to automate what happens when an affiliate generates a lead. The Lead Created trigger can start a workflow for affiliate-attributed leads, while the Add Leads under an Affiliate action can assign contacts to an affiliate and campaign.
Trigger: Lead Created
What it does

The Lead Created trigger starts a workflow when a new affiliate-attributed lead is created.
You can apply it across all campaigns or filter to trigger for a specific campaign only.

How to Use It

From the Sub-Account view, go to Automation → Workflows, then click + Create Workflow
Set the Trigger as Lead Created 
To target a specific campaign, click Add filters → Campaign → Is select the campaign, then click Save Trigger.  Leave the campaign filter blank to apply the trigger across all campaigns.  [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081573599/original/XjizIzCTeWk82a2rxw6wRaSLqDO8ygs6fg.png?1790087531] 
Add actions like:
Send email to affiliate
Notify internal team
Use custom values from the Lead Created  section in emails/messages [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046919760/original/XaZPVUfJB0b4WuoOJkd_o9uYMyuMWuZ-Fg.png?1747737844] 
Save and publish your workflow

Use Cases
Send a “Congrats!” email to affiliates when they generate a lead
Alert your sales or support team about new affiliate leads
Automatically track and tag affiliate leads for nurturing
Action: Add Leads under an Affiliate
What it does
The "Add Leads under an Affiliate" action assigns a contact (lead) to an affiliate and their associated campaign, making sure affiliates are correctly credited.

You can now choose from three assignment methods for total flexibility.

How to Use It

In your workflow, add the action: Add Leads under an Affiliate

Choose your assignment method:

Manual

Auto (Attribution)

Custom Mapping

Configure additional fields based on the method

Save and publish the workflow

Assignment Methods
1. Manual : Manually assign a lead to a known affiliate in a specific campaign.
Best for: Form submissions, internal routing, admin decisions.
Steps:
Select campaign
Select affiliate (from affiliates in that campaign) [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046514809/original/CcKuxYwq4yOIQ_cx6E4yJDvAb3NnJEwUdA.png?1747119576] 
2. Auto (Attribution via URL) : Automatically assign leads using am_id passed in the URL parameters.
Supports first or last click attribution.
Steps:
Choose Attribution Method: First / Last
Make sure am_id is passed earlier in the funnel (e.g., form/page URL) [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046514824/original/COmOzfhsvwzF7jK5RHBib1SjxVAI-szQpA.png?1747119591] 
3. Custom Mapping : Use if am_id is stored in a custom field or passed as a workflow value.
Best for: API pushes, third-party systems, hidden fields on forms.
Steps:
Choose mapping source: custom field or workflow value
System reads value and assigns the lead to the matching affiliate [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046514851/original/cYBBMy6l6rRl8DKAaM8P4WCbLdraHVPOFw.png?1747119602] 

Use Cases
Reward Lead Generation
Example: A lead fills a form → system assigns them to the affiliate who shared the link → sends a “Congrats!” email.
Custom Lead Nurturing
Example: Leads from a funnel are assigned to specific affiliates for 1-on-1 follow-up — boosting conversion rates.
Simplify Administrative Tasks
Example: Replace manual lead assignments with automation — perfect for busy teams managing many affiliates.
